# JobConnect AI
> AI-powered platform connecting professionals worldwide
> with remote and cross-border job opportunities

## What we do
JobConnect AI uses artificial intelligence to match job seekers
with remote-friendly and cross-border roles — regardless of
location, language, or nationality.

11 languages. 63 countries. Free to start.

## Who we serve
- Professionals seeking remote or international career opportunities
- Anyone looking to work across borders without relocation barriers
- Employers hiring globally for remote and distributed teams

## Key pages
- /jobs : Remote & cross-border job listings with AI match scoring
- /candidate : Candidate dashboard with application tracking
- /employers : Post a job, reach global remote talent
- /pricing : Plans and pricing

## Core features
- AI job matching with visible 0-100 match score
- Multilingual job search (11 languages)
- AI cover letter and CV generation adapted by country
- Application tracking dashboard
- Skill gap analysis
- LinkedIn profile optimizer
- Interview preparation assistant
